title: PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI
summary: A nonlinear response to a vehicle command, applied as PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI:drive, :steer, :brakes0 or :brakes1: command values, and per command value a graph of the response over speed. The walkers parse every applied instance on a prim that lists one of the four, reading physxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponse:<inst>:commandValues, speedResponsesPerCommandValue and speedResponses.

interactions.rule: The brakes0 and brakes1 instances shape the response of the braking system of the same instance name.

notes: Its columns are not described yet.
